Journey.Order.Title: Start with an order number, or skip it.
Journey.Order.Subtitle: An order or reference number names the files saved in this session, on this PC and in the cloud. Leave the field empty to keep the recordings' own titles.
Journey.Order.Help: Up to 64 characters. Windows does not allow \ / : * ? " < > | in file names, or a full stop at the end. Invisible characters from pasted text are removed. The number is not remembered after the app is closed.
Journey.Order.Invalid: This order number cannot be used as a file name. Remove characters such as \ / : * ? " < > | and any full stop at the end. Names that Windows reserves for devices, such as CON, NUL or COM1, cannot be used either, alone or before a full stop.
Journey.Order.NamesByTitle: No order number: saved files keep the recordings' titles.
Journey.Order.NamesByOrder: One recording is saved as {0} plus the file extension, for example {0}.mkv. When more than one recording is saved under this order number in a session, the order number becomes a prefix: {0}_recording title.mkv.
Journey.Order.NamingHelp: The extension follows the file type chosen on the Preserve page; an exact copy keeps the extension the recorder gives it. An existing file is never replaced; a number in brackets is added instead. Cloud uploads use the same names.
Journey.Order.SummaryNone: No order number is set: files keep the recordings' titles. Enter one in step 00 to name files by order.
Journey.Order.SummarySingle: The file is named {0} plus its extension.
Journey.Order.SummarySeveral: Files are named {0}_recording title plus the extension.
Journey.Library.Title: Choose the recordings to save.
Journey.Library.Subtitle: Connect to your recorder first; its recordings are then listed here.
Journey.Library.ConnectHelp: Use the button below to find your recorder on the home network.
Journey.Preview.PlaybackError: Windows could not play this video
Journey.Preview.PlaceholderHelp: Up to 45 seconds of the recording, with its original picture and sound.
Journey.Media.Units: Inspected with MediaInfoLib. Duration is reported in seconds; sizes in bytes and bitrates in bits/second.
Journey.Preview.PlaybackErrorHelp: Windows may lack the required video or audio codec. You can still see the details of recordings and save them. {0}
Journey.Preview.UnavailableHelp: Preview is unavailable on this Windows installation. Its media playback components or codecs may be missing. You can still browse recordings, see their details and save them. {0}
Journey.Cache.SpaceRequired: There is not enough free space in {0}. At least {1} is needed for this step.
Journey.Media.Field.Title: Title
Journey.Archive.Title: Saved files.
Journey.Archive.Subtitle: What was saved in this session. Open the folder, or upload a copy to your cloud.
Journey.Archive.EmptyTitle: Nothing has been saved in this session yet
Journey.Archive.EmptyHelp: Save a recording to see the file here, with the result of its check and its technical details.
Journey.Archive.VerificationHelp: Each file below says how it was checked. The technical details hold the full report.
Journey.Archive.SelectHelp: Tick the files you want to upload.
Journey.Archive.Compare: Technical details · recording and saved file
Journey.Archive.InCloudAs: Uploaded to {0} at {1}, stored there as {2} because the name was taken
Journey.Cloud.Title: A copy in the cloud
Journey.Cloud.Help: Upload the ticked files to your own OneDrive or Google Drive. Nothing is uploaded until you choose to.
Journey.Cloud.HelpFolder: Upload the ticked files to the shared OneDrive folder set in Settings. Nothing is uploaded until you choose to.
Journey.Cloud.WhereOneDrive: Files go to the top folder of your OneDrive. If a name is already taken there, OneDrive stores the new file under a different name; nothing is replaced.
Journey.Cloud.WhereOneDriveFolder: Files go to the shared folder set in Settings, not to the top folder of your OneDrive. If a name is already taken there, OneDrive stores the new file under a different name; nothing is replaced.
Journey.Cloud.WhereGoogle: Files go to the top level of My Drive. Google Drive keeps a second file under the same name if one already exists; nothing is replaced.
Journey.Cloud.SeeFiles: See what is in the cloud
Journey.Cloud.SetupHelp: Uploading needs a sign-in to the chosen service; Manage connections opens it. A file that was already uploaded is not recognised: uploading it again stores it twice.
Journey.Cloud.SelectHelp: Tick one or more files above to upload them.
Journey.Cloud.NothingSaved: Files saved in this session appear above and can then be uploaded. A file saved earlier can be added with Add files from this PC.
Journey.Cloud.SelectionRequired: Tick at least one file to upload.
Journey.Cloud.ConnectHelp: The Connect button for {0} is highlighted below. Sign in, then go back and try again.
Journey.Cloud.ReconnectHelp: The saved sign-in to {0} is no longer accepted. Connect again with the highlighted button below, then go back and try again.
Journey.Cloud.NotEnoughSpace: {0} has {1} free, and the ticked files need {2}. Free some space there, or untick files, and upload again.
Journey.Cloud.FailedHelp: The files that were not uploaded are still ticked: choose Upload to try them again.
Journey.Cloud.StoppedHelp: {0} of {1} files were uploaded to {2} before you stopped. The others are still ticked; the file that was being sent has to start again.
Journey.Cloud.AddedSource: This file was added from this PC; the application did not save it in this session.
Journey.Cloud.AddedSummary: Added from this PC for upload. It was not checked by the application.
Journey.CloudView.Title: What is already in your cloud.
Journey.CloudView.Subtitle: A read-only look at your cloud storage. Nothing is downloaded and nothing is changed.
Journey.CloudView.SelectorNote: This is the same choice as on the Archive page: it also decides where uploads go.
Journey.CloudView.OneDriveScope: Shows the top folder of your OneDrive, where this app puts its uploads. Everything in that folder is listed, not only recordings.
Journey.CloudView.OneDriveFolderScope: Shows the shared folder set in Settings, where this app puts its uploads. Everything in that folder is listed, not only recordings.
Journey.CloudView.GoogleScope: Shows only the files this app uploaded with your Google client. Google does not let it see anything else in your Drive.
Journey.CloudView.Privacy: The application reads names, sizes and dates only when you ask, and keeps the list only until you close the application.
Journey.CloudView.NotListed: Choose List the files to see what is stored there.
Journey.CloudView.EmptyGoogle: This application has not uploaded anything to this Google Drive yet. Other files in the Drive are not visible to it.
Journey.Archive.FolderUnavailable: This folder is no longer available.
Journey.Cloud.AgainMessage: Already uploaded to {0} in this session: {1}. Uploading again stores a second copy there.
Journey.CloudView.Truncated: The list is incomplete: only its first part could be read (items shown: {0}), and the newest files may not be among them.
Journey.Dlna.SelectInspect: Tick a recording and choose Download and show details.
Journey.Dlna.ConnectHelp: The search looks only on your home network and starts only when you choose Find network recorders.
Journey.Dlna.DeviceRequired: Find and choose a recorder first.
Journey.Dlna.AddressHelp: If the search finds nothing although the recorder is on, your network may not pass the search between Wi-Fi and cable. Type the recorder's address, which its network settings show, and ask it directly.
Journey.Dlna.NoneAtAddressHelp: No recorder answered at {0}. Check the address in the recorder's network settings, and that its home-network (DLNA) server is switched on.
Journey.Dlna.Finding: Looking for recorders on your home network…
Journey.Dlna.NoneFoundHelp: Go through the checklist below, then search again.
Journey.Dlna.Checklist.Title: If your recorder is not found
Journey.Dlna.Checklist.On: Switch the recorder on. A recorder in standby does not answer.
Journey.Dlna.Checklist.Server: Switch on its network server (DLNA) in the recorder's network settings, then leave the settings menu.
Journey.Dlna.Checklist.Network: Connect the recorder and this PC to the same router. A guest Wi-Fi network or a VPN on the PC keeps them apart.
Journey.Dlna.Checklist.Others: Stop other devices that are playing from the recorder, and wait until the recorder is not recording or copying.
Journey.Dlna.CatalogueHelp: Open a folder and tick the recordings you want to save.
Journey.Dlna.LibrarySubtitle: Open a folder and tick the recordings you want to save. You can preview a recording first.
Journey.Dlna.OriginalNotice: Copy-protected recordings, and recordings the recorder offers only in a converted version, cannot be saved.
Journey.Dlna.ListAccessible: Recordings in this folder. Recordings that cannot be saved cannot be ticked.
Journey.Dlna.SelectAvailable: Tick all that can be saved
Journey.Dlna.DownloadNotice: Both first download the whole recording to a temporary folder on this PC, which takes time and space. The recording downloaded last in this way is not fetched again when you save it, unless its folder was refreshed in between. Nothing on the recorder is changed.
Journey.Dlna.EmptyFolder: This folder is empty, or the recorder did not return any accessible entries.
Journey.Dlna.NoMatches: No titles match this filter. Clear it to see this folder again.
Journey.Dlna.StatusUnknown: Can be saved · the recorder does not say whether this is the original version
Journey.Dlna.StatusConverted: Offered only in a converted version · not saved by this application
Journey.Dlna.StatusUnavailable: The recorder does not offer this recording for download
Journey.Dlna.StatusSaved: Saved in this session · tick it only to save it again
Journey.Dlna.UnavailableCount.one: {0} recording in this folder cannot be saved:
Journey.Dlna.UnavailableCount.few: {0} recordings in this folder cannot be saved:
Journey.Dlna.UnavailableCount.many: {0} recordings in this folder cannot be saved:
Journey.Dlna.UnavailableCount.other: {0} recordings in this folder cannot be saved:
Journey.Dlna.SelectDownloadable: Tick a recording to preview it or see its details.
Journey.Dlna.ExportSubtitle: Choose the folder and the form in which the recordings are saved. Picture and sound are never re-encoded.
Journey.Dlna.ExportSelectHelp: Tick one or more recordings first.
Journey.Dlna.KeepUnchanged: Exact copy, as the recorder delivers it
Journey.Dlna.KeepAndRemux: The same picture and sound in an easy-to-play file
Journey.Dlna.UnchangedNotice: The exact copy keeps every byte the recorder sends and needs no extra program. The easy-to-play file holds the same picture and sound, repackaged by FFmpeg and compared with the download before the download is removed. MP4 and MPEG cannot hold every kind of picture and sound; a recording that does not fit is not saved in that type, and the message says so. The choice is remembered.
Journey.Dlna.FileTypes: File type of the saved files: {0}
Journey.Dlna.SelectionRequired: Tick one or more recordings first.
Journey.Dlna.OutputAbsolute: Enter the folder with its full path, for example D:\Recordings, or use Choose folder.
Journey.Dlna.TotalUnsupported: The recorder advertises a size total beyond supported disk limits. Refresh the catalogue or reduce the selection before downloading.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxInspectionPending: Saved and checked. Reading the file's details…
Journey.Dlna.RemuxVerification: Checked: the file holds the same video, sound and subtitle streams and has the same length as the download, which was then removed. The download's size and SHA-256 fingerprint are in the technical details.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxInspectionCancelled: Saved and checked. Reading the file's details was cancelled.
Journey.Dlna.SavedHelp: Each recording was saved exactly as the recorder delivered it. The details are in Archive.
Journey.Dlna.SavedContainerHelp: Each recording was saved as one easy-to-play file and compared with its download, which was then removed. The details are in Archive.
Journey.Dlna.SavedContainerKeptHelp: At least one download was kept beside its file. Archive shows the reason for each.
Journey.Dlna.RemuxVerificationKept: Checked: the file holds the same video, sound and subtitle streams as the download. The download was kept as a separate file.
Journey.Dlna.DeliveredKeptFailed: The easy-to-play file could not be completed, so this download was kept.
Journey.Dlna.DeliveredKeptDuration: The file's length differs from this download's or could not be compared, so both files were kept.
Journey.Dlna.DeliveredKeptLocked: The file was checked, but this download could not be removed. You can delete it yourself.
Journey.Dlna.FailedMore: …and others that could not be saved (number: {0}).
Journey.Dlna.NotAttempted: Further recordings not tried: {0}, because two in a row failed.
Journey.Dlna.LeftoverPartials: Incomplete files left in this folder by an interrupted earlier save were removed (files: {0}, {1}).
Journey.Dlna.LeftoverDownloads: This folder also holds complete downloads that an interrupted earlier save left under working names (files: {0}, {1}); their names begin with “.diga-”. Each is a whole recording as the recorder delivered it: rename one to keep it, or delete it.
Journey.Dlna.FailedHelp: The recordings that were not saved are still ticked: choose Save to try them again. Saved recordings are in Archive.
Journey.Dlna.KeptAsExactCopy: It was kept as an exact copy instead; that file is in Archive.
Journey.Dlna.StoppedHelp: {0} of {1} recordings were saved before you stopped; they are in Archive. The others are still ticked.
Journey.Dlna.RecordingSizeUnsupported: The recorder advertises an unsupported recording size. Refresh its catalogue before downloading a preview.
Journey.Dlna.Found.one: Found {0} device. Choose your recorder and connect to it.
Journey.Dlna.Found.few: Found {0} devices. Choose your recorder and connect to it.
Journey.Dlna.Found.many: Found {0} devices. Choose your recorder and connect to it.
